content.title: McDonald’s answers major customer question for Easter 2026
content.text: Key PointsMcDonald’s has revealed whether it will be open on Easter Sunday 2026.The fast-food giant offers limited-time "KPop Demon Hunters" adult Happy Meals, ongoing 2026 value deals with $5 meal bundles, and in-app exclusive offers.Customers are advised to confirm local hours using the McDonald’s restaurant locator and app. Fast food is deeply embedded in American culture, and McDonald’s continues to lead the industry decades after its founding. With a menu spanning breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late-night cravings, the chain remains a go-to for millions of customers every day. That’s why questions about holiday hours, especially on widely observed occasions like Easter, tend to spark curiosity. Whether it’s a last-minute breakfast run, a quick meal between family gatherings, or simply a daily routine, many customers want to know if their favorite spot will be open. Holiday schedules, however, aren’t always straightforward. While some businesses close entirely to allow employees time off, others operate on reduced hours or leave decisions up to individually franchised locations. This can make it difficult to know what to expect without checking in advance. Below is what customers can expect from McDonald’s on Easter 2026, along with tips to avoid any surprises. Is McDonald’s open on Easter 2026? Yes, all McDonald’s (MCD) restaurants nationwide are expected to be open on Easter 2026, but hours may vary by location. The company has built a reputation as one of the most reliable fast-food chains, as it remains open on major holidays, including Easter. More coverage on McDonald’s offerings: McDonald’s revives two popular collaborations in new Happy Meal McDonald’s finally brings overseas fan favorites to US in 2026 McDonald’s revives 36-year-old fan-favorite Happy Meal toy collab However, there’s an important detail to keep in mind. The majority of McDonald’s locations are independently owned and operated franchises. Because of this, individual restaurants may adjust their hours, including opening later or closing earlier for the holiday. With more than 40,000 locations across over 100 countries, finding an open restaurant is typically not difficult. However, checking ahead is still the best way to avoid any inconvenience. Customers are encouraged to use the official McDonald’s restaurant locator on its website or mobile app to confirm their local store’s Easter hours before heading out. McDonald’s reveals that it will be open on Easter 2026.Shutterstock McDonald’s current Happy Meal collaboration McDonald’s has partnered with Netflix (NFLX) to launch the first-ever “KPop Demon Hunters” adult Happy Meal. Customers can scan the QR code on the access card using the McDonald’s App by April 26 to unlock first access to exclusive content and participate in a limited-time interactive experience inspired by the film. Current value deals at McDonald’s In response to customer feedback about rising prices, McDonald’s introduced the McValue menu and Extra Value Meals, among other value-focused offerings, in 2025, aimed at budget-conscious diners. These deals continue into 2026, alongside rotating in-app promotions. 2026 McDonald’s offers In-app exclusive: Free Snack Wrap with $1 minimum purchase when downloading the app $5 Meal Deals: 4-piece Chicken McNuggets, small fries, a small soft drink, and a sandwich of choice Breakfast McValue deal: Buy one select breakfast item, get another for $1 Dinner & Lunch McValue deal: Buy one select lunch/dinner item, get another for $1 For the latest promotions, customers should check the app regularly, as offers may vary by location and time.
